scope: Phase 1 feasibility, licensing decision and typed receiver contract; Phase 2 gated on feasibility and not started because Phase 1 concluded no-go. Nickel fixtures only; nothing built, bundled or operated.
decision: no-go: rustpush is SSPL v1 with an exception limited to OpenBubbles, OpenAbsinthe is public only as a stub, anisette needs macOS AOSKit or a remote service whose submodule is uninitialized, and an Apple ID account and genuine Apple identifiers are required. See docs/imessage-receiver-feasibility.md.
durable_capability: config/imessage-receiver.ncl, a receiver contract over the unchanged kiln.webhook-notification.v1 payload, kept for a separately licensed future receiver.

checks.result: pass: the positive profile exports and ten negative profiles are each refused by the field they violate

non_claims: No receiver, account, hardware identity or message delivery exists or was exercised.
A later receiver needs a separately recorded decision under satisfied prerequisites.
